meta_description: PS Plumbing & Heating Services Ltd offer expert plumbing and heating across Leicester. Fast response, honest pricing, fully qualified. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Qualified & Insured — Fast Response Across Leicester
hero_subhead: Leaks, boiler breakdowns, or heating faults fixed fast — so your home stays warm, dry, and stress-free.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full heating installations, we handle every job with care, skill, and transparent pricing.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, or sudden plumbing failures handled swiftly to minimise damage to your property. We aim to reach you the same day, so small problems don't become costly disasters.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Supply and fit of energy-efficient boilers from leading manufacturers, tailored to your home's heating demands. We handle the full process from removal of your old unit to commissioning and safety checks.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing keeps your system running safely and efficiently, helping to prevent unexpected breakdowns. We diagnose and repair faults on all major boiler makes and models.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Full central heating installations, upgrades, and power-flushing services to restore flow and efficiency throughout your home. Radiator repairs, replacements, and thermostatic valve upgrades also available.

services.title: Bathroom & Wet Room Installation
services.desc: Full or partial bathroom installations, from suite fitting to tiling-ready pipework and waste connections. We work cleanly and efficiently, leaving you with a functional bathroom on schedule.

services.title: General Plumbing Works
services.desc: Tap repairs, toilet cistern fixes, washing machine connections, outside tap installations, and more — all handled by a trusted local professional. No job is too small for PS Plumbing & Heating.

about_pullquote: Every job done right — because your home deserves nothing less.
about_para_1: PS Plumbing & Heating Services Ltd was founded with a straightforward mission: to provide Leicester homeowners and businesses with reliable, high-quality plumbing and heating work at fair prices. With over a decade of hands-on experience, our fully qualified team has built a solid reputation across the city and surrounding areas.
about_para_2: We believe in honest communication, tidy workmanship, and standing behind everything we do. Our customers return to us time and again because they know they'll receive a straight answer, a competitive quote, and a job finished properly — first time.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called PS Plumbing after a pipe burst under the kitchen sink on a Friday evening. They arrived within two hours, sorted the problem cleanly and charged a very fair price. Absolutely brilliant service — would not hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler fitted last month and the whole experience was seamless. Turned up on time, explained everything clearly, and left the house spotless. The heating is working perfectly. Top-quality workmanship from a friendly, professional team.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: I've used PS Plumbing twice now — once for a leaking radiator and once for a full bathroom tap replacement. Both times they were prompt, polite, and priced honestly. It's refreshing to find a local tradesperson you can genuinely trust.
reviews.author: James R.
